about.statement: Designer by craft, developer by habit. I make AI products feel simple.

medicine.title: Emergency physician
medicine.description: Ten years in emergency departments after graduating from the Universidad Nacional de Córdoba. Still the best training I've had in deciding fast with incomplete information.

about.heading: About
about.designCodeBody: I mix solid design principles with practical, efficient development to create clean, responsive, and pixel-perfect interfaces. I take care of the whole process — from early research to prototypes to bringing everything to life with smooth, modern code.

productDesign.title: Product Design
productDesign.description: Advised product strategy and design direction across multiple client projects, aligning business goals with UX decisions and working alongside developers to ensure high-quality delivery.

uiDeveloper.title: UI Developer
uiDeveloper.description: Delivered end-to-end digital products—from research and wireframes to polished, high-performance interfaces—for international Web3 and DeFi clients.

webDesigner.title: Web Designer
webDesigner.description: Designed and developed responsive websites and apps for multiple concurrent projects with international teams, ensuring accessibility and optimal user experience.

webDeveloper.title: Web Developer
webDeveloper.description: Built e-commerce platforms, landing pages, and corporate websites with custom features and styling, while managing maintenance and security optimizations.

noHandoff.title: Design and code, no handoff
noHandoff.body: I design in Figma and take it to production myself. What gets decided in design reaches the product intact, without back-and-forth between teams.

ai.title: AI where it actually saves time
ai.body: I build automations and agents with n8n and LLMs to take repetitive work out of the way, and I design AI products that feel simple to the people using them.

decide.title: Deciding with incomplete information
decide.body: Ten years in emergency rooms taught me to prioritize fast, ask just enough, and move without waiting for certainty that isn't coming.

remote.title: Remote, with teams anywhere
remote.body: Since 2021 I've worked remotely with international teams and clients, in Spanish and English.

clients.title: Have a project?
clients.body: Tell me what you want to build. In a short call we'll see if it's a fit and how to start.

teams.title: Building a team?
teams.body: If you're looking for someone who designs and builds product, here's my full track record.

dogs.title: Spock and Mina
dogs.body: My two dogs: Spock is 12 and Mina is 6 months old. They're my favorite models.

photo.title: Photography
photo.body: I'm an amateur photographer. I study photography and go out shooting around Córdoba, the city I love.

print.title: 3D, from screen to hand
print.body: I model in 3D and turn it into real objects with my printer, which is almost never off.

design.title: Design everywhere
design.body: Interiors, graphic, web: I'm always looking at how others design. And when I travel, I soak up everything I can from each culture.

brief.title: Get a personalized brief
brief.intro: Describe what you want to build in your own words. I'll generate a real project brief in 30 seconds — scope, timeline, price range, and what I'd ship first.
placeholderRotation: We're a Solana validator and need a delegator dashboard with on-chain reward claims…
I want to add a smart chat to my SaaS that can answer questions about our docs…
We need to redesign our DeFi swap UI to feel less intimidating to new users…
I have a startup landing page idea and need it shipped in two weeks…
